words.ex: As towns spread further into the foothills, shrinking habitats leave snow leopards with fewer places to hunt.
The school garden club planted wild flowers instead of lawn grass to increase biodiversity and attract more bees and butterflies.
The school eco-club adopted an endangered species, the Turkestan lynx, and raised money for the reserve that protects it.
Even the most stubborn climate change sceptic in our debate club changed his mind after studying thirty years of temperature records.
Our geography teacher showed us two photos of the same glacier taken fifty years apart; because of global warming, it had shrunk to half its size.
Switching the city's buses from diesel to electric power should cut carbon emissions significantly.
Our school still heats its classrooms with a coal boiler, but the head teacher wants to stop relying on fossil fuels and install heat pumps.
In our science lesson we left a thermometer inside a closed glass jar in the sun to show how the greenhouse effect traps heat.
Thousands of extra visitors each summer exert severe pressure on the mountain village's small water supply.
Since gas is one of the country's finite resources, the government is already planning what will replace it when the fields run dry.
Releasing a foreign fish into the lake upset the ecological balance, and several local species soon disappeared.
Villagers in the hills above Bostanliq say that deforestation has left the slopes bare, so every spring the rain washes the soil away.
The town council studied demographic projections to decide how many new schools the district will need in ten years' time.
The number of electric cars in the city has grown exponentially, almost doubling every year.
Fishermen on the lake have to sail further every year to find fish, a clear sign of depleting resources.
On the small island, waste disposal is a real headache, because all the rubbish has to be shipped to the mainland.
The old battery factory was closed after toxic waste was found leaking into the river.
Chemicals from nearby fields have contaminated the village well, so the water is no longer safe to drink.
During the long, dry summer, water in the village became such a precious commodity that neighbours took turns at the only working pump.
Lining the old canals with concrete is part of the government's plan to improve water security for farmers in the south.
In the worst-case scenario, parts of the coastal city could be under water by the end of the century.
High in the mountains, the lakes are still pristine, with crystal-clear water and not a single piece of litter.
The airline planted a million trees in an attempt to improve its green credentials.
The prophets of doom said the new park would never attract anyone, but it is now full of families every weekend.
The new eco-village was planned with sustainable development in mind: local building materials, rainwater tanks and jobs for local people.
The school roof is now covered with solar panels, so most of its electricity comes from renewable energy.
The spring floods caused serious damage to the roads, and some villages were cut off for days.
